standardized_task.definition: Predict whether any sensor will cross the predefined critical safety boundary (|z| > 3.5) within forward horizon H = 15 seconds
standardized_task.dataset: Kaggle NPP Industrial Telemetry (50,000 continuous time-steps)

key_takeaway: On the identical binary prediction task (detecting boundary breach within 15s), PRAJNA achieves F1 = 0.6358 (Precision = 0.4671, Recall = 0.9953) versus Isolation Forest F1 = 0.4788 and Autoencoder F1 = 0.4699. Traditional anomaly detectors lack temporal trend extrapolation and suffer from high false alarm rates.
